brief_item: Collect, organize and analyze a full list of requirements.
note: One row per numbered brief item, with the page that answers it, a status, and an official source.

brief_item: Outline the important details in an executive summary.
note: The root executive summary and this section's summary both use $10-rounded values.

brief_item: Anonymize personal information; placeholders only; internal-use facts must not appear on the site.
note: Property A / Property B placeholders, no name, street address, postal code, APN or utility account; local links still reveal jurisdictions to a reader who opens them.

brief_item: Property A is inherited; Property B is already owned by the inheritor. Factor that into the analysis.
note: Deed not seen; headroom and reassessment shown both under the statement and as a contingency.

brief_item: Separate section for black-swan economic conditions that mimic non-uniform growth and inflation over 50 years.
note: Part 1 is official history and baseline anchors; part 2 replays verified episodes against the decision.

brief_item: Use costs and numbers rounded to the nearest $10 so they cannot be traced online; report them in the decision analysis.
note: Roll values and bills are generalized further to $10,000 / $100 for privacy; this exceeds the brief's $10 rule and is flagged for the owner.

brief_item: Trust inheritance around 2040-2050, guided by current local, state and federal property and tax law.
note: Future years are scenarios, not forecasts; statutory deadlines are from current code.

brief_item: Live in, rent, or sell and reinvest after taxes; include property tax, insurance, water, electricity and step-by-step inheritance.
note: All options are cashed out and taxed at the end of the comparison window; unverified insurance premiums stay blank.

brief_item: Water, solar electricity credit, primary-residence insurance research, maintenance and repair costs.
note: No official insurer quote exists; water and solar credit are owner-supplied, and the 20-year tariff depends on an unknown interconnection date.

brief_item: Current market estimate and 2014-2026 property-tax and assessed-value history.
note: Current estimate is owner-supplied; duplicate tax amounts and the missing 2026 bill are flagged.

brief_item: Current market estimate, 2016-2025 property-tax and assessed-value history, and the three-unit rental setup.
note: Fixed charges, rate year and one assessment-year irregularity are flagged; no 2026 figures were supplied.

brief_item: Two rented units, one available unit, rental income, water, electricity and landlord insurance research.
note: No official landlord premium; rent increases are capped for sitting tenants, and the local proposal is not enacted.

brief_item: Keep Property B in view when guiding the decision for Property A.
note: The recommended plan keeps Property B; the ownership asymmetry changes estate room and basis treatment.

brief_item: Project property tax, repair/maintenance, electricity, water and insurance year by year.
note: Insurance is blank; electricity credit ends in a scenario when the legacy tariff period expires.

brief_item: Clean, organized, streamlined decision process that removes uncertainty; state the best plan and why.
note: Break-evens, sensitivities and the assumption register are published; no manual input is required.

brief_item: Maximize profit and lower costs using projections based on inflation, economic and tax factors.
note: All options are compared after tax and selling costs in nominal and inflation-adjusted terms.

brief_item: Research potential changes to laws currently being discussed and their effect on the decision.
note: The inherited-property initiative failed; 2026 results are unofficial until certification; future thresholds are scenarios.

brief_item: Research inheritance tax thresholds at local, state and federal level, headroom, and future projections.
note: No state or local death-transfer tax; cash balance, gifts, marital status and portability are unverified and left blank.

brief_item: No manual input; work line by line from official verified sources; no hallucinations.
note: This independent ledger records the exact words relied on and how each document was checked.

brief_item: Review the repository line by line, provide links for manual review and flag irregularities.
note: Root audit page records prior corrections; this section adds the independent traceability and source log.

brief_item: Create a GitHub Pages live site with a clean landing page and subpages organized by category.
note: No forms, scripts, analytics or remote assets; the published artifact uses an allowlist.

brief_item: Contain all entries and findings in simple tables; every table row links to an official site; unverified values blank and flagged.
note: The verifier fails on any table row without an official link, on PII patterns, and on any non-$10 dollar amount.

brief_item: Use COORDINATION.md, claim non-overlapping scopes, commit/push claims, rebase before pushes, log conflicts.
note: Claims on separate branches are invisible from main until merged; the board register documents the overlap.

brief_item: Create a PR from the integration branch, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy, publish a Flagged for Review page.
note: The PR link and merge result are recorded in COORDINATION.md; flagged items do not block the merge.
